mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM auth_permission p INNER JOIN auth_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN auth_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM auth_permission ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_permission (permission_name, permission_code, description, create_time) VALUES (#{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_role_permission WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
